question: For which groups of practitioners are the stated ritual instructions intended?
premises: Ritual instructions can apply to different groups.
Vedic followers and others are distinguished.
Both women and men are included.
inference: The instructions apply to Vedic followers and others, including both women and men.
uncertainties: The syntactic completion of this verse depends on the following verse.
plain_english: O one of good vows, for Vedic followers and likewise for other women and men...
